claim: Subtiel is a one-star Michelin restaurant at Westhoeklaan 31, De Panne, run by Stéphane Buyens and Ellen Dulst in a seaside villa beside the dunes.
quote: Stéphane Buyens and Ellen Dulst have created an enchanting seaside villa with welcoming interior details including parquet floors, a period fireplace and a terrace flanked by lush green dunes.

claim: Subtiel itself does not run rooms; it directs diners to Visit De Panne to find their own accommodation.
quote: There are various accommodations in De Panne. Discover them all on the website of Visite De Panne.

claim: A taxi from De Panne to Veurne takes about 7 minutes for 5 km at roughly €25–35.
quote: A taxi takes 7 minutes and costs $27 - $35, and the distance is 3 miles.

claim: The Dumontwijk is De Panne's oldest villa quarter, designed by Albert Dumont with Art Nouveau and Art Deco cottages, and sits between the town centre and the sea.
quote: The overall design is the work of Belgian architect Albert Dumont... a real gem, unique on the Belgian coast.

claim: Parkhotel De Panne sits at Albert Dumontlaan 30 inside the heritage Dumont quarter, ~200 m from the sea, with 39 rooms plus 3 villas and 2 studios.
quote: Albert Dumontlaan 30, 8660 De Panne... 39 spacious rooms, plus 3 villas and 2 studios available... Approximately 200 meters from the beach.

claim: Parkhotel is described as cottage-style Art Deco villas with a garden 250 m from the sea, in the historic Dumont quarter.
quote: The Parkhotel is a charming place to stay with its cottage style art deco villas and pretty garden... 250 meters from the sea.

claim: Villa Bon Papa is a 1924 listed villa in the Dumontwijk, restored 2017–2018 as a three-room B&B with private bathrooms and an authentic staircase.
quote: de oudste villawijk van De Panne... Drie luxueuze kamers, elk met eigen badkamer... volledig gerenoveerd in 2017-2018.

claim: Villa Bon Papa scores 9.6 on Booking.com (181 reviews) with a 9.8 location score; guests highlight breakfast and hospitality.
quote: Rated 9.6 by recent guests, with an excellent location score of 9.8 based on 181 reviews.

claim: Maison Botanique is a self-catering ground-floor apartment in the Belle Époque villa 'Les Lauriers' (c. 1910) at Bortierlaan 22, sleeps 4, 200 m from the beach.
quote: Bortierlaan 22, 8660 De Panne, Belgium... part of an authentic Belle époque villa located in the beautiful historic Dumont district... 200 meter walk from the Belgian North Sea beach.

claim: Hotel Villa Select is a four-star family-run seafront hotel at Walckierstraat 7, De Panne, with indoor pool, sauna, hammam and direct beach access.
quote: Walckierstraat 7, 8660 De Panne... right by the sea... Indoor swimming pool, sauna, and Turkish bath.

claim: The Villa Select building was built in 1911 in neogothic style at the Zeedijk/Walckierstraat corner, originally housing the Pâtisserie Saint-Antoine on the ground floor from 1918.
quote: Construction of the Select began in 1911... built in 1911 in neogothic style.

claim: Hotel Donny is a four-star family-run hotel a stone's throw from the De Panne beach, with indoor pool, children's pool, spa and sauna.
quote: four-star hotel by the sea... swimming pool, spa, fitness-sauna-Turkish bath.

claim: Auberge De Klasse is a heritage-listed 1725 building in the historic centre of Veurne, ranked #1 of 11 Veurne B&Bs on Tripadvisor with a 5/5 average.
quote: Auberge De Klasse is ranked #1 of 11 B&Bs / inns in Veurne and rated 5 of 5 at Tripadvisor... restored heritage-listed building dating from 1725.

claim: 't Kasteel & 't Koetshuys is a period house B&B 0.2 miles from Veurne's centre with 8 individually decorated rooms (some with fireplaces), garden eggs at breakfast, and a 9.2 Booking.com score.
quote: 0.2 miles away from the center of Veurne... 8 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring fireplaces... breakfast includes fried eggs from the hens in the back garden... overall score of 9.2 based on 69 reviews.

claim: Boutique Hotel Hof ter Duinen, Albert I-Laan 141 Oostduinkerke, is a 20-room four-star family-run hotel 100 m from the dunes and sea, with spa, sauna and on-site restaurant Bistronomie Eglantier.
quote: 20 renovated rooms... brand new boxpring beds... spa center with sauna, Turkish bath, spa bathtub... 100 meters from the beach, dunes, and sea.

claim: Hof ter Duinen sits roughly 7 km (about 4.4 miles) from central De Panne — a 10–15 minute taxi ride via the N34 coastal road.
quote: located at Albert I-laan 141, 1.2 miles from the center of Oostduinkerke... 4.4 miles from the Hof ter Duinen hotel.

claim: Visit De Panne curates a list of 'unique' B&Bs in De Panne for travellers seeking character lodging beyond the standard hotel stock.
quote: Unique B&Bs | De Panne... special bed and breakfast hotspots have been selected where you will be welcomed with open arms.
